parsed.rationale: Both participating records live in test files: `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` (package `Metadata`) and `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` (package `app:iOS`). Although the context flags do not set `is_test: true`, the file paths unambiguously place both declarations inside `Tests/` directories, making them test-local mock error types. Each test target independently defines `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.MockError` to satisfy its own mock resolver fixture; consolidating them would couple two otherwise-independent test targets and risk leaking test-only types into shared production code. No action is warranted.
